findings.desc: quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/handlers/review-inventory.ts:400 captures candidateArtifactInvalid but discards it; a truthy non-array persisted candidates value present before the first review_inventory_begin still signs and returns State: OPEN with no candidate digest.
